description: The pie chart represents the distribution of data sources in the combined training set for a study on automatic evaluation of attribution by large language models. There are a total of 11 slices, each corresponding to a different data source. The largest slice, representing 31.3%, is attributed to "NQ," followed by "SNLI" at 15.4%, and "VITAMING" at 13.0%. "MULTINLI" accounts for 11.3%, "SUMHUL" for 1.6%, "SCIFACT" for 0.1%, "SCITAIL" for 1.2%, "PUBHEALTH" for 0.5%, "FACTCC" for 2.6%, "ENTFA" for 1.8%, and "ANLI" for 4.6%. The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices, and the slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way. The segments are ordered by size, with the largest slice at the top and the smallest at the bottom.
